purpose: Persistent CRICZONE Telegram assistant rules and provider directory. Edit this file to change bot behavior without repeating instructions.

response_rules.match_query: For any two teams and any separator (vs, v, versus, against), show provider names only.
response_rules.provider_query: After provider selection, show each real channel name with its CRICZONE page URL.
response_rules.exact_sony: Only exact 'sony' returns https://criczone.pages.dev/sony/. 'sony sports' must use the Sony Sports provider channel list.
response_rules.channel_selection: When a user selects a channel, return only that channel name and its page URL.
response_rules.privacy: Never expose upstream stream URLs, DRM keys, cookies, tokens, or credentials.
response_rules.quality: Deduplicate channels, exclude unrelated broadcaster channels, tolerate minor spelling mistakes, and never invent a channel or ID.
response_rules.sony_primary: Show the seven Sony Sports channel-ID entries in sony_channel_sets.primary first. Each item includes its exact name and URL.
response_rules.sony_backup: Only if the user reports the primary Sony channel is not working, show the criczone1 alternate entries in sony_channel_sets.backup.
response_rules.willow_cricbuzz: For direct Willow or Cricbuzz requests, reply only with https://criczone.pages.dev/criczonebuzz/. Willow provider/channel search may include curated Willow USA entries in folder e when the user asks for Willow channels.
response_rules.fancode_web: For 'fancode' or provider selection FanCode, list available FanCode channels and append FANCODE WEB with https://criczone.pages.dev/criczonefancode/. For exact 'fancode web' or 'fan code web', reply only with the folder URL.
response_rules.sky_fox_tnt: Sky provider must return only the 28 curated Sky Sports records from telegram-channels.json source manual_directory. Preserve each record's exact folder and ID URL. Deduplicate by folder+ID and normalized channel name; do not mix other feeds.
response_rules.tnt: For TNT requests, return only the four curated TNT Sports channels from telegram-channels.json source manual_directory. Use exact /e/?id= URLs. Do not mix unrelated feeds.
response_rules.star_sports: For Star Sports requests, use curated Star Sports channel records from telegram-channels.json (source manual_directory), return channel names with their exact folder-specific CRICZONE page URLs, deduplicate by folder+ID and normalized name, and do not rely on sony_star feed.

curated_directory.rule: Use channel id + name + folder + url from this file as trusted CRICZONE metadata; do not re-scrape or ask the user to resend it.
